to see a real-time composite risk score for each active customer on a single dashboard
I can immediately identify which accounts need my attention without manually pulling data from multiple sources
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Dashboard displays risk score (0-100) for all active customers | 2. Risk score updates within 24 hours of any data change | 3. Color coding: Green (<30) / Yellow (30-50) / Red (>50) | 4. Clicking a customer row opens their detailed health profile

to receive a Slack notification when a customer's risk score increases by 15+ points in 7 days
I can proactively reach out before the customer decides to cancel
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Slack message sent within 1 hour of threshold breach | 2. Alert includes: customer name, plan, MRR, risk score, top 3 risk factors | 3. No duplicate alerts within 24 hours for the same customer | 4. Alert links directly to customer dashboard

to see which onboarding stage each new customer is currently in and how long they have been stuck there
I can intervene early when customers hit blockers instead of discovering it at the 30-day check-in
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Onboarding tracker shows all 5 stages with current customer stage highlighted | 2. Days-in-stage counter displayed per customer | 3. Red flag shown if customer stuck in same stage > 5 business days | 4. Blocker field captured and visible to CSM

to receive a guided onboarding checklist with clear instructions for each step immediately after account creation
I can set up the platform independently without waiting for a CS call
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Checklist emailed to customer admin within 1 hour of account creation | 2. Checklist contains 5 stages with description, estimated time, and required resources per stage | 3. Customer can mark steps complete from within the app | 4. Completion percentage visible on customer's home screen

to view a dashboard showing open ticket volume
Priority: and average resolution time by category in real time
Story Points: I can allocate team resources proactively and prevent SLA breaches before they happen
column10: 1. Support dashboard refreshes every 15 minutes | 2. SLA breach indicator shown per ticket (green = within SLA, red = breached) | 3. Category breakdown chart shows ticket distribution and avg resolution time | 4. Escalated tickets highlighted separately

to receive an automated status update when my support ticket has been assigned and when it is resolved
I know my issue is being handled without needing to follow up manually
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Automated email sent when ticket status changes to 'In Progress' | 2. Resolution email includes summary of fix + link to knowledge base article if applicable | 3. CSAT survey link included in resolution email | 4. Emails sent within 5 minutes of status change

to see a monthly executive report showing churn rate trend
Story Points: I can present accurate business health metrics to the board without manually compiling data from multiple sources
column10: 1. Report auto-generated on the 1st of each month | 2. Includes: churn rate (MoM delta), onboarding completion %, open at-risk MRR, avg health score | 3. Report downloadable as PDF | 4. Prior 6 months shown for trend analysis

to paste raw customer feedback into the platform and receive structured pain point analysis and draft user stories
I can translate unstructured customer voices into backlog-ready requirements 10x faster than manual analysis
Acceptance Criteria: 1. AI returns structured analysis within 15 seconds | 2. Output includes: sentiment %, ranked pain points, root cause categories, 4-6 draft user stories | 3. Download option available (.txt format) | 4. Analysis clearly labels AI-generated content with 'Review before use' disclaimer

to input a business problem statement and automatically generate a BRD excerpt with user stories and UAT test cases
I can produce first-draft requirements artifacts 5x faster and use my time for validation and stakeholder alignment instead of writing from scratch
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Output generated within 20 seconds | 2. BRD excerpt includes: problem statement, objectives, scope, assumptions | 3. Minimum 5 user stories generated in correct Agile format | 4. Minimum 5 UAT test cases in Given/When/Then format | 5. All outputs downloadable

to filter the customer dashboard by plan type
Story Points: I can focus my analysis on the specific customer segment I manage without wading through irrelevant data
column10: 1. Filter panel visible on dashboard with plan / region / industry dropdowns | 2. All charts and tables update dynamically when filter applied | 3. Active filters shown as removable tags | 4. Filter state persists during session

to have all customer health signals stored in a SQL-accessible schema with a documented data dictionary
I can build reliable data pipelines and support ad-hoc reporting without reverse-engineering undocumented tables
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Schema documented with table name, column name, data type, description, example value | 2. ERD diagram published and versioned in the repository | 3. All foreign key relationships enforced | 4. Data dictionary exported as CSV and PDF

to receive a weekly automated report on onboarding completion rate by plan type and the top 3 blockers causing delays
I can identify systemic onboarding failures and prioritize product or process fixes accordingly
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Report emailed every Monday 9:00 AM | 2. Shows completion rate by plan (Starter/Growth/Enterprise) | 3. Top 3 blockers ranked by frequency | 4. Trend vs prior 4 weeks included

to see all previous tickets for a customer in a single view before responding to a new ticket
I can provide context-aware responses without asking customers to repeat information they have already provided
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Customer ticket history accessible from ticket detail page | 2. History sorted by date descending | 3. Shows: ticket category, priority, resolution time, satisfaction score | 4. Loads in < 2 seconds

to see the projected MRR at risk based on current at-risk customer cohort and historical churn rates
I can make informed decisions about CS team resourcing and retention budget allocation
Acceptance Criteria: 1. MRR-at-risk calculated as: sum of MRR for all customers with risk score >= 50 | 2. Displayed as dollar amount and % of total MRR | 3. Historical comparison shows if at-risk MRR is improving or worsening | 4. Updates daily

to have AI-generated user stories automatically tagged with story points estimate and MoSCoW priority
I can import them into Jira with minimal manual editing
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Story points assigned based on complexity scoring (1/2/3/5/8) | 2. MoSCoW tag applied (Must Have / Should Have / Could Have) | 3. Output formatted for Jira CSV import | 4. Tags are editable before download
